items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: like Benny Goodman has the Boyum system

ctx.x: It's a difference in the fingering? Or?

Yes, the fingering. The fingering, you make F1 a different way. You make B flat a different way. You make C a different way. Those three notes. And on the new improved system, you can make one note two different ways. Whereas on the Albert system, you learned it one way, and you made it that one way. Was the tone different? The tone, I think, is bigger on the Albert system. It's better for jazz. Because it has a more mellow, more jazzy sound. Whereas the Boyum system has, like Benny Goodman has the Boyum system.…
And with the system, the newer system, is your speed quicker?
